# Known Limitations – My Big Tracing Day v1.0

- **AI-generated images.** The six photo-style pictures (cover trio + five day scenes) and the three portraits cropped from the cover image were generated with Figma AI (model gpt-image-2.5-sunburst) on 12 Nov 2026. They are not photos of real children. Disclose this on Amazon KDP (required) and wherever your marketplace asks. Check Figma's current AI terms for commercial use with your plan.
- **Image resolution.** The AI images are 1536 × 1024 px. Full-width placements print at about 200–220 dpi (below the 300 dpi ideal); small portraits print well above 300 dpi. KDP's previewer may warn about the larger photos. For a sharper print edition, upscale or regenerate at 2048 px and rebuild.
- **Character consistency.** Portraits on every page come from ONE approved image, so they are identical. The five scene photos were generated separately; the friends look very similar but small differences (hair, clothes details) exist. Review them.
- One wall sign containing AI-invented text in the original group image was blurred out.
- **No physical print or KDP proof yet.** Order a proof copy; check photo colours and dark areas (the bedtime scene) on paper.
- **Spine width** computed as 78 × 0.002252 in for white paper; premium colour paper may differ slightly – confirm in KDP's cover calculator and rebuild if needed.
- Paperback pages print on both sides – crayons or pencils are recommended; reward stickers are cut out from the paper itself.
- PPTX photos and illustrations are pictures; text, shapes and dotted lines are native. Canva import not tested.
- Nothing was uploaded to Shopify or Amazon.
